page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top; a page number at the head left. No marginal notes. Below the text a single catchword-like mark "τὸ" at the lower right, set apart. The page is a Greek paradigm table set in three columns under the text.

main_text.p: Etiã à quibusdam substantiuis comparatiui & superlatiui formãtur, τὸ κέρδος, κερδίων, κέρδιστος.

page.notes: The Greek is printed with the old ligatured and abbreviated forms; the transcription above regularises some letter forms.
